deviations: Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

SCR-121's content stack (find bar, capacity line, the grid's place) is spaced by space.stack.md (12 px), the kit's STEP for SCR-120's band step (D1 L114): no source sets SCR-121's vertical rhythm (kit choice).
The counts inside cap.over ('6', '5', '14 August 2026') keep the string's type (type.ui.body), as on boards 22 and 28: one sentence that wraps at 1280, and cvsheet v1 has no mixed runs.

The find bar (§7 L294-296) is local compositions: the CMP-054 SearchBox as a 320 × 32 px well (the kit field's width; no source sets it) on color.surface.sunken with DS-3's color.text.tertiary boundary and the registry 'search' glyph in color.text.tertiary (6.83 on sunken, the edge 6.29 against the page, §15 L650), empty, so no 'Clear search' button (15:541); the CMP-055 FilterBar with its add-filter controls 'Role' and 'Status' (15:548; L295) as 32 px secondary triggers with a trailing chevron (text and chevron color.text.primary, 10.17 on the secondary fill, §15 L641), none set. Neither carries a value or a placeholder: no source gives one (copy gaps).

The over-cap line (D12 L125; §7 L315) is the kit's capacity_line('over'): no CMP-023 meter and no tone glyph (the kit's choice, 'a bar cannot show more than its cap', argued here). D12's words are '6 sub-accounts in use · Regular tier allows 5', not cap.recorded's '{used} of {cap}' that a meter's cap.valuetext would read ('6 of 5'), and CMP-023's value runs 0-100 (15:253), so a bar cannot show 6 of 5; D12 names no tone (§7 L314 gives the warning tone to at capacity only). Used and cap were both read, which allows a meter (L315-316) without requiring one; board 91 draws the seven variants (L316), so the spec owner settles it there.

The over-cap numbers are D12's own (L125): 6 sub-accounts in use under the Regular tier's cap 5 (Y:20859), overriding §1's '3 sub-accounts in use' (L103) for this frame, as U-6's 'used > cap' needs (L337); the tier stays §1's Regular (L103). cap.over is D12's literal (§14 L605 'over D12'): no fills.
Links: 'Change' (cap.over's [Change]) is underlined by a 1 px rect (see the underline line); it is the board's only link.

'Change' follows plain text, so it carries a drawn 1 px color.text.link underline as wide as its estimated text (cvsheet v1 texts take no underline; boards 01, 22, 23 and 28): a link marked by colour alone fails against the text beside it. Its box is 32 px tall with the word centred, the comfortable target (§13 L591; §4 L176).
